scope: SSE/SZSE daily market and security-status facts
full_day: An untimed S row without a daily bar retains the existing full-day inference. An untimed S row with an actual positive-volume bar is a traded day with an unspecified halt boundary, never a proven full-day halt. Explicit intervals covering all trading opportunities conflict with a traded daily bar and fail.
partial_day: Parse literal ordered nonoverlapping comma-separated H:MM/HH:MM intervals from 09:00 through 15:00. A halt leaving some trading opportunities may coexist with a same-security/date finite positive-volume daily bar. Preserve the daily bar and set the full-day is_suspended flag false. normal_active means an observed traded day, not uninterrupted trading.
opening_auction: 09:30-15:00 starts after the 09:25 opening match. The daily bar proves trading but does not identify intraday execution times; do not invent an auction execution assertion.
failure: Malformed/reversed/overlapping timing, intervals covering all trading opportunities, missing daily evidence and nonpositive volume fail closed.
raw: Supplier timing and daily payloads remain unchanged and bound through ordered Raw refs.
qualification: best_effort terminal supplier evidence; no verified intraday PIT claim
untimed_counterexample: 000055.SZ 2015-07-06: supplier timing null, daily positive volume, issuer announcement 2015-32 explicitly confirms intraday suspension. Empty timing cannot universally prove no intraday trading.
